method: Serial fresh processes in A-B-B-A order for each workload/presolve. Per-case ratios are candidate/baseline pooled case medians. Adjacent ratios use exact row keys. All rows retained; synthetic warmups excluded from timing summaries. Descriptive, not significance estimates.
scope: Eight frozen public Netlib families and twelve synthetic LP cases on this Windows host. Synthetic sequences are repeated stateless solves; public reuse uses retained native HiGHS models. Public timing includes first calls and stronger candidate certificate coverage.
limitations: Numerically verified with unchanged tolerances, not exact rational primal certificates.
Only two process repetitions per version; OS background activity uncontrolled.
Fixed-vector replay is A-B only and used for correctness, not a timing headline.
No learned routing promotion, production-user data, release or universal speed claim.

post_campaign_diagnostic.purpose: Investigate regressions retained in primary campaign using fixed primal/dual vectors; verifier-only timing, no replacement of end-to-end results.
